note: Two briefs chosen before generation by the 2026-11-15 decision panel: one representative, one adversarial. Each is run once with the skill and once with no skill. Assertions are checked by scripts/grade_eval.py where marked [script], otherwise by an independent grader reading the outputs.

evals.name: launch-film-from-real-plugin-material
evals.prompt: Make a 20-second 16:9 launch video for the design-craft plugin. Everything about it is in /Volumes/LLMs/Dev/fledgeling-plugins/plugins/design-craft (README, icon, banner, skill). I won't be around to answer questions, so make the calls yourself and give me the MP4.
evals.expected_output: A directed 15-30 s 1920x1080 film with sound, made from the plugin's real icon and words, with a non-empty first frame, a hook in the first 3 s, readable holds, and a written plan made before the build.
assertions: [script] An MP4 exists in outputs, 15-30 s long, 1920x1080
[script] The MP4 has an audio stream
[script] Frame 0 is not a flat field: its luma range (YMAX-YMIN) is at least 40
[script] The picture changes within the first 3 s: mean absolute difference between the frames at 0.0 s and 3.0 s is at least 2.0

[script] The plugin's real icon file is used: a byte-identical copy of plugins/design-craft/assets/icon.png or icon-256.png or icon.svg sits in the project, or the composition references one of those paths
[script] No banned hype word (seamless, unlock, supercharge, game-changer, revolutionize, effortless) appears in any composition source file
A written plan with per-shot or per-beat timing exists in the project and predates the composition files (by file modification time or by the run's own account)
Every product claim on screen can be found in the plugin's README or SKILL.md

evals.name: csv-to-vertical-clip-one-liner
evals.prompt: turn this into a 15 second vertical clip for instagram /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-lukerhodes-Dev-dAIolog/71aa0a44-4a67-4066-96bc-90723a122818/scratchpad/motion-craft-workspace/inputs/ridgeline-orders-2025.csv
evals.expected_output: A 10-20 s 1080x1920 clip whose every figure matches the CSV (7,145 orders in 2025, the November peak of 1,187, January to December up 119%, repeat customers 31% to 42%), readable with the sound off, with key text clear of the platform UI bands.
assertions: [script] An MP4 exists in outputs, 10-20 s long, 1080x1920
[script] Frame 0 is not a flat field: its luma range (YMAX-YMIN) is at least 40
[script] The picture changes within the first 3 s: mean absolute difference between the frames at 0.0 s and 3.0 s is at least 2.0
[script] At least one headline figure computed from the CSV (7145 or 7,145; 1187 or 1,187; 119%) appears in the composition source
Every figure shown on screen is derivable from the CSV, and a chart, if present, has a zero baseline or a labelled truncated axis
The clip's message reads with the sound off: on-screen text carries the point rather than narration alone
Key text sits inside the centre band, clear of the top 10% and bottom 20% of the frame

dropped_assertions.text: [script] No number in the composition source text contradicts the CSV
dropped_assertions.reason: In iteration 1 it fired on both arms for layout coordinates (YBASE = 1150, y: 1194, y: 1130, y: 1180), not on-screen claims, so it measured code rather than the film. Figure accuracy is judged by the grader instead.
